full_page.content:
April 30,
Well the waited-for coppies have come finally and I am sending the first one to you W.V. Bedolfe and at last thanking for those precious books. I find it a great advantage, to pray to the Holy Ghost - Third Person of the Blessed Trinity before reading them.
Sincerely yours. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
1953, April 6
Message written on the back of a photo of Fr. Solanus "
Bles'd be God in all His designs.
April 6 - 1953
God bless you Wallace - Wallace Bedolfe and all your dear ones.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C.
0 Lord Jesus! Blessed God! Teach us appreciation that we may learn something of the first and surest practical indication of intelligence - Gratitude for favors received. . . . . . According to Pope Pius XII Man's first and gravest duty is just that. Gratitude for favors received.
